text:
ana: Quick kickoff  OSS refapp launch package. Goal: community-first narrative that ties blog, tiny tutorials, benchmarks, and a live Q&A. Need sequencing + lead routing. Who's in? cc @ravi @harper
ravi: I'm in. Proposed sequence: 1) short announcement blog (bench highlights + CTA), 2) 3-day micro-tutorials drip (email + GitHub labels), 3) live demo + panel. Blog should have a one-paragraph TL;DR, 2 charts, and a 2-line runnable snippet.
harper: For the benchmark narrative: surface reproducible numbers and methodology. Call out: test workload, hardware, batch strategy, and cost calc. Suggest a small "how we measured" collapsible in blog linking to the raw notebook. Avoid sensational claims.
zoe: Lead routing: event signups -> HubSpot list "community-content" tag oss_sprint_2026. Tutorial repo downloads/stars -> add to segment "devrel-nurture". Webinar watchers who ask product questions -> create ticket in sales queue with label "potential-poc". Capture utm_source, utm_campaign, and referral.
sam: I'll draft the blog skeleton and the micro-tutorial outlines. Can someone export the perf PNGs and a short GIF of the local run? GIF helps social.
harper: Will export charts. Quick preview: 2.8x lower unit cost vs baseline on our sample workload when using batching+cache; median latency 140ms p95 320ms on 4xA40 in this run. I'll save CSVs + a light notebook.
nana: (typo) ana: meant @harper :)
ravi: A/B test two headlines: A) "Ship LLM inference locally with our OSS refapp" B) "See how we reduced inference cost 2.8x  refapp + benchmarks" Track headline CTR and tutorial repo clones.
zoe: For the HubSpot form minimal fields: name, email, company, role, primary use case (dev/prod/research), permission checkbox, and a hidden field campaign=oss_sprint_2026. Also add a checkbox "want a sales follow-up" for enterprise leads.
sam: Code snippet for blog (keep it tiny):
```
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-oss.git
cd refapp-oss
./quickstart.sh --model mosaic-mini
```
Use same snippet in tweet thread.
harper: Methodology note to include: seed prompts (2K tokens), 1M tokens total, disabled logging for performance, warmed KV cache, batching window 20ms. Include p50/p95/p99 plots.
marketing-bot: Artifact uploaded: /drive/marketing/oss-sprint/benchmarks_2026-03-21.zip by harper at 2026-03-21T09:12Z
ana: timeline proposal: blog draft Thu EOD, tutorial pieces Fri-Mon, webinar next Wed. Social: 1 announcement thread + 2 followups / week.
ravi: CTA funnel: blog -> tutorial sign-up -> tutorial drip -> webinar. Set up a referral pixel for the repo so we can attribute clones from emails.
zoe: I'll map conversion stages in HubSpot and add list filters for "downloaded-refapp", "registered-webinar", "watched-recording". Also set automation: if someone registers + downloads, send 'getting-started' onboarding email with repo link.
sam: I'll make the header image and 3 social cards. Need the chart PNGs from harper and a short quote for the header. Can someone draft a one-line quote from an engineer?
harper: Quote: "You can run inference locally and keep costs practicalwe measured 2.8x savings without sacrificing responsiveness." Use if needed.
nana: action items: harper = export PNGs + notebooks (today). sam = draft blog skeleton + social cards (tomorrow). zoe = HubSpot form + automation (today). ravi = write headline variants + blog intro (tomorrow). I'll own scheduling + review.
zoe: HubSpot form created, hidden field campaign=oss_sprint_2026, list created.
harper: Uploaded CSV + PNGs to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/oss-sprint/2026-03-21 (acl: marketing, devrel). Also pushed a small notebook to GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-oss/tree/main/benchmarks.
sam: Draft PR opened for blog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing-site/pull/482 - includes skeleton and snippet.
ravi: Will post headline variants to #marketing-review for quick votes.
nana: Great. Keep comments here for blockers. We'll sync again if any timing slips. :sparkles:
